headline: Google Drive search upgrade fails with AI Overviews
summary: New search feature causes confusion, slower results
details: Google Drive's new search upgrade, AI Overviews, has been met with frustration. The feature, which aims to make it easier to find files, has been described as a 'confusing mess' by many users.

The AI Overviews feature provides responses to questions that users never asked and is slow. For example, searching for a specific file can take longer than expected, with users having to wait for a conversational summary.

Users can bypass the AI Overviews by using specific search keywords and operators. For instance, typing a filename or using the '/' key can provide a list of suggested matches without engaging the AI.

Additionally, one-word searches, such as 'receipt' or 'finance', will perform standard searches without AI Overviews. Using search operators, like 'in:all', can also override the AI and turn the search into a standard Drive search.
